name: saga-pattern-ecommerce
description: E-commerce Saga Pattern Example with Node.js, TypeScript, Docker, and Kafka

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:risk" "npm run dev:inventory" "npm run dev:payment"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:services
scripts.build:services: cd services/order-service && npm run build && cd ../risk-service && npm run build && cd ../inventory-service && npm run build && cd ../payment-service && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:services
scripts.test:services: cd services/order-service && npm test && cd ../risk-service && npm test && cd ../inventory-service && npm test && cd ../payment-service && npm test

author: Diego Nieto
